research_scope: Validate freshness and association of scheduler-native encoder backlog snapshots with subsequent request admission and API TTFT, without activating them as a content-pruning or deadline controller.

snapshot_transport.source: scheduler process emits count-only JSON datagrams over loopback UDP
snapshot_transport.receiver: run manager binds an ephemeral loopback port and atomically publishes a latest-state JSON file
snapshot_transport.polling: client reads the latest file immediately before submitting each image request
snapshot_transport.controller_use: observation only; no budget decision reads this snapshot

cells.purpose: Independent burst validation using the pre-frozen v0.3 predictor strictly for error analysis.
Independent uniform-arrival validation of snapshot availability and queue-state transitions; no burst predictor is extrapolated to this cell.

analysis: Record snapshot availability, age, and each scheduler counter at image arrival.
Join every image by engine request ID to first encoder admission and visual CUDA stage timing.
Compare snapshot counts with pre-existing HTTP-future pending-image count and actual engine-submit-to-admission queue time.
Report missing snapshots and contradictory state as observations; do not tune coefficients or declare a pass/fail threshold from these two cells.
Keep heldout QA untouched and retain keep-all for every request.

source_constraints.flickr_api_key: excluded by user; do not acquire or use
source_constraints.docvqa: public Hugging Face val only; no private test or RRC account
source_constraints.rights_status: this synthetic scheduler probe does not affect dataset rights or eligible-item counts
